title: Hyperdimensional Reality
description: The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.

puzzle.goal: Every universe is a false vacuum that buds daughter universes by quantum tunnelling: bubbles nucleate at rate λ per volume per time, suppressed by the exponential of the thin-wall bounce action for a wall of tension σ separating vacua whose energy densities differ by ε. A universe of volume V lives a time τ, and the tree is followed down to D generations. Write the expected number of universes in the tree.
puzzle.name: Branching multiverse with Coleman–De Luccia bubble nucleation
puzzle.ask: Call the bracket b, the mean number of daughters per universe; the sum is a geometric series. Find N for b = 3 and D = @{D}.

vars.\u03bb: nucleation prefactor per volume per time

puzzle.method: Generation j holds b^j universes on average. The tunnelling exponent is the Euclidean action of an O(4)-symmetric bubble, B = 27π²σ⁴/(2ε³), from extremising 2π²R³σ − (π²/2)R⁴ε over R.
